column1: Purpose: Track every sales opportunity from Application through Closed Won or Closed Lost so you can calculate your real Close Rate.
1. Create one row per unique sales opportunity. Reschedules, second calls, and reapplies during the same process stay on the original row, don't create a new one.

2. Check off each milestone as the opportunity moves through your pipeline: Application Submitted > Call Booked > Call Shown > Qualified > Offer Sent > Closed Won > Closed Lost > No-Show > Unqualified.
3. Backfill your last 6 to 12 months of sales calls first. Pull from your CRM, calendar, application form, call recordings or notes, payment processor, contracts, or setter records.
4. After the backfill, update every opportunity as it moves through your process, in real time going forward.
